value.rationale: The theorem answers a natural inverse risk-allocation question: whether separately specified lower- and upper-tail probabilities can coexist under only a fixed mean and variance. It gives a complete classification, not merely a universal upper bound on their sum. The exact strict-boundary cases matter because the middle interval is open and atoms at its endpoints count as tail events.
